violations.text: The doors to the outside, located in the (front area), are not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2026

Observed a hole in glass divider. Cardboard was used in the construction of divider in the freezer cooler. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning must be constructed of a nonabsorbent and smooth material. New Violation. Correct By: 08/13/2026

The following non-food contact surfaces have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: -bottom shelves of coolers and freezer coolers -beverage cooler located in front of aisles 34 & 33 -shelves throughout aisles New Violation. Correct By: 08/13/2026

The floors in the (retail) area have an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 08/13/2026

The floor and wall junctures in the back storage area & mop sink area do not have coving, observed exposed sheet rock with holes. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. New Violation. Correct By: 08/13/2026

The door to the outside, located at the front entrance, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 02/21/2025

The floor and wall junctures in the back storage area & mop sink area do not have coving, observed exposed sheet rock with holes. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. New Violation. Correct By: 02/21/2025

The floors and walls throughout the facility have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 02/07/2025

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the back storage area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 02/07/2025
